payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image read as a chalk drawing, rather than mainly as a softened or blurred image with grain?
node.criteria: Pass if the scene’s forms and edges visibly have a drawing-like chalk rendering, not merely a chalk-like surface texture or haze. Fail if it remains primarily photographic or blurred with only a texture effect. Unknown if the evidence is insufficient to distinguish these.
node.binding: Compare the edited image with the source. Inspect whether the forms and edges across the scene read as a chalk-made drawing; recognizable forms or grain alone do not establish this. Use the ancestor observation as context, but assess this proposition independently.

dependencies.evidence: Compared with the original photograph, the edited image has a visibly softened, grainy, hand-drawn appearance with chalk-like shading and outlines across the giraffes and background.
